candidates.legal_status: official state publication; public information in the sense of the Law on Access to Public Information

candidates.why_relevant: Stage-specific view of which bills are currently sitting with which committee — exactly the committee-stage dimension of this cell. Lets the pipeline be sliced by lead committee (finance/tax/customs) rather than by keyword alone.

candidates.source_name: Законодавство України (zakon.rada.gov.ua) — official legal database
candidates.why_relevant: The official consolidated text database. Each act has a stable /laws/show/{id} URL, dated consolidated redactions ('редакція від ...'), a 'Прикінцеві та перехідні положення' block carrying entry-into-force and transition deadlines, and a card of amending acts. This is where an adopted bill becomes a citable, versioned law.
candidates.access_status: public; occasionally rate-limits / bot-defends aggressive crawlers
candidates.legal_status: official state publication; free reuse of legal texts
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Track a watchlist of act IDs; fetch /laws/show/{id} plus the 'Картка документа' and the redaction list; diff consolidated redactions to detect newly effective provisions; parse final-and-transitional provisions for dated obligations.
candidates.discovered_via_method: seed query; confirmed via search results resolving to /go/ and /laws/show/ identifiers

candidates.why_relevant: The anchor banking statute. Its amendment history page enumerates every adopted law that touched banking regulation, giving a retrospective index of the whole A3 pipeline and the outer deadlines the NBU implements by regulation.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor the redaction list for a new dated version; when one appears, pull the amending act number and back-resolve it to its bill card on itd.rada.gov.ua.
candidates.discovered_via_method: uk seed query

negative_findings.description: No documented REST/JSON API returning an individual bill card (проходження, committee conclusions, reading dates) was found. The open-data portal exposes the bill register as periodically refreshed dataset files under /open/data/zpr, not as a per-bill query endpoint.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched the Rada open-data portal catalogue and API documentation page; found dataset passports and CSV/JSON/XML file downloads only.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Near-real-time stage tracking will require HTML scraping of Card pages in addition to the bulk datasets, which raises fragility and rate-limit risk; the collection design must budget for both paths.

negative_findings.description: Committee висновки/рішення appear as file attachments on bill cards and in committee meeting materials, but no single searchable index of banking/payments committee conclusions was located.
negative_findings.result_summary: The committee site exposes decisions, protocols and stenograms by meeting rather than by subject; retrieval is per-meeting or per-bill.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Any conclusions corpus must be assembled by crawling meetings and bill cards; a topic query alone will not retrieve it.

negative_findings.description: The Verkhovna Rada English site publishes only selected news items; there is no English mirror of the bill register, bill cards, or the legal database.
negative_findings.result_summary: English seed query returned Rada English news articles and NBU English releases, but no English bill-search surface.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: All A3 pipeline collection for Ukraine must be built on Ukrainian-language sources; English is only a reporting/terminology layer. Downstream translation must be planned in.

negative_findings.description: «Офіційний вісник України» full text is distributed through commercial channels rather than as an open searchable archive; publication dates are practically obtained from the document card on zakon.rada.gov.ua instead.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search returned the legal framework (Presidential Decree No. 503/1997) and commercial ОВУ distributors, not an open ОВУ archive.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Entry-into-force computation should rely on the zakon.rada.gov.ua document card's publication reference rather than on the gazette itself.

negative_findings.description: Opendatabot was named in Ukrainian-language material as a bill-monitoring service, but no specific Opendatabot legislative-monitoring product URL was confirmed in this pass, so it is not listed as a candidate.
negative_findings.result_summary: Query mentioned it; results did not resolve to a verifiable legislative-monitoring endpoint.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Avoids recording an unverified source; flagged for a targeted follow-up rather than invented.

coverage_gaps.description: Plenary stenograms (стенограми пленарних засідань) and roll-call vote records were not individually profiled, though the meetings/zal datasets point at them. Debate text often reveals the political viability of a banking bill before the vote.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Profile the stenogram surface (w1.c1.rada.gov.ua / rada.gov.ua stenograms) and the голосування dataset in a follow-up pass; link to bill numbers.

coverage_gaps.description: Only the Finance/Tax/Customs committee was profiled as lead. Banking and payments bills are regularly co-executed by the European Integration committee (EU-approximation conclusions, directly relevant to PSD2/EMD alignment deadlines) and the Anti-corruption committee (mandatory expert assessment).
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Add the European Integration committee site and its висновки щодо відповідності праву ЄС, plus the anti-corruption expertise stream, in the next scouting pass.

coverage_gaps.description: Adjacent primary-legislation topics that sit at the edge of banking/payments — virtual assets (віртуальні активи), financial monitoring/AML (фінансовий моніторинг), consumer lending (споживче кредитування), deposit guarantee (ФГВФО) — were not searched as separate keyword families.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend the bill-register keyword watchlist beyond банк*/платіж* to these families and re-run the register search.

coverage_gaps.description: The itd.rada.gov.ua search form is an ASP.NET postback form; whether it supports stable GET-parameter queries (needed for reproducible automated searches) was not established.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Technical probe of the search form's request shape; if only POST/viewstate, plan a headless-browser collector or rely on the zpr open-data dataset as primary.

coverage_gaps.description: Public-discussion/consultation surfaces attached to draft laws (committee 'обговорення проєктів законів', committee and parliamentary hearings, working-group announcements) were seen in the committee site navigation but not profiled as distinct sources.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Map the committee's hearings and public-discussion sections to dedicated candidate entries with their own collection cadence.

brief: Ukraine's primary-legislation channel for banking and payments is unusually well instrumented and almost entirely Ukrainian-language: the Verkhovna Rada bill register ('Законотворчість', itd.rada.gov.ua/billinfo) carries a per-bill card with initiators, lead committee, attached explanatory notes and comparative tables, reading dates and vote events, while zakon.rada.gov.ua holds the resulting acts as dated consolidated redactions whose 'Прикінцеві та перехідні положення' set the transition deadlines the NBU subsequently implements. Critically, the same material is republished as bulk open data (data.rada.gov.ua datasets zpr, zak, zal, meetings, explicitly free to reuse commercially), so the pipeline can be tracked machine-readably rather than by scraping an ASP.NET search form. Around this spine sit the upstream feeder (Cabinet draft laws at kmu.gov.ua/bills), the substantive shaping layer (the Finance, Tax and Customs Policy committee at komfinbank.rada.gov.ua, with meeting protocols, stenograms and висновки), and the closing gates (presidential signature at president.gov.ua and official publication in «Голос України»/«Офіційний вісник України», which fixes the date entry-into-force clauses count from). English coverage is a thin news layer only, and commercial systems such as LIGA:ZAKON are useful cross-checks but paywalled and not collectable.
